items.title: Attorney advertising
items.text: This site may be considered attorney advertising. Corrowen & Ivesmark LLP is a fictional firm; its bar numbers are invented.

items.title: No attorney-client relationship
items.text: Reading this site or sending information to the firm does not create an attorney-client relationship. That happens only with a signed engagement letter after a conflict check.

items.title: Prior results
items.text: Representative matters describe past results. Prior results do not guarantee a similar outcome. Matters are anonymized and fictional.

items.title: Not legal advice
items.text: Insights and library documents are general information, not legal advice for your situation.

items.title: This is a demo
items.text: Wendlow, its courts and the firm's people are invented. Phone numbers use the 555 range. There are no contact, intake, payment or registration forms on purpose.
